source.publication: 2025 Montana Individual Income Tax Return Form 2 and Form 2 Instructions
source.section: Form 2 PDF p1 lines 1-8 and PDF p2 worksheet lines 1-13; Instructions PDF p12-13 lines 1-8; PDF p17 tax calculation; PDF p18 rate tables; Instructions PDF p21 Schedule I Part I Line 1; Form 2 PDF p3 line 1; record muni_interest; Form 2 PDF p1 lines 3 and 7 ('If zero or less, enter 0'); Instructions PDF p13 Line 7

worked: Federal (given, not tested): federal AGI = wages (person 0) 10,000.00 = 10,000.00. Municipal interest is not in federal AGI. Federal taxable income = 10,000.00 - standard deduction 15,750.00 = -5,750.00, floored at 0.00 (Form 2 line 3 does the same) (federal senior deduction ignored). Filing status single, no Montana standard deduction or exemptions. Schedule I Part I: line 1 other-state bond interest 8,000.00; line 7 additions 8,000.00; line 24 subtractions 0.00. Form 2 page 1: line 1 federal AGI 10,000.00; line 2 Form 1040 lines 12e and 13b 15,750.00; line 3 0.00; line 4 8,000.00; line 5 0.00; line 6 age 65 subtraction 0 x 5,660.00 = 0.00; line 7 Montana taxable income 0.00 + 8,000.00 - 0.00 - 0.00 = 8,000.00. Page 2 worksheet: line 1 taxable income 8,000.00; no net long-term capital gain, so lines 2-10 are skipped and line 11 is 0.00; line 12 ordinary income tax from the PDF p18 rate table: 4.7% x 8,000.00 = 376.00; line 13 = 376.00, carried to page 1 line 8. Bracket schedule as numbers (the expected figure): 4.7% x 8,000.00 = 376.00. Line 9 nonrefundable credits 0.00; line 10 tax after credits 376.00. Line 3 is floored at 0.00 before the addition on line 4, so the 5,750.00 of federal deduction above income is lost and does not offset the addition: 10,000.00 - 15,750.00 is -5,750.00, entered as 0.00, then 8,000.00 is added. An unfloored start would give 2,250.00.
